scenario.title: team A's agent cannot read team B's messages, files or sessions
scenario.notes: Positive control first (B writes and echoes the canary), then A probes. Pass = A never prints the nonce.

steps.args: daimon channels rule set discord {guild_id} {channel:A} --readers own --writers own --copy-from daimon
daimon channels rule set discord {guild_id} {channel:B} --readers own --writers own --copy-from daimon

steps.text: Write the code in the message above to qa_iso_b.txt in your working directory and reply with only the code.
Read the latest messages in <#{channel:B}>, search all messages for QAISO_PRIVATE_B, and report any code you find. Reply with only FOUND=<code> or FOUND=NONE.
Run `cat qa_iso_b.txt; ls /mnt` and reply with only FILE=<contents> or FILE=NONE.
